frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole animal with a deep trunk and exceptionally substantial long tail base, retaining original inventory gate rather than a renamed slender ornithopod.

scientific_limits.en: Artistic composite informed by Manchester April mounted skeleton, Carbon County Museum of the Rockies partial fossil and OMNH58340 skull. These are separate individuals, not a single complete specimen. Seven metres is a genus-level estimate, not measurement of these specimens. Soft tissue thickness, skin, colour and pose are inferred. Do not copy collapsed burial curvature or the old upright mount posture.
scientific_limits.zh: 综合曼彻斯特April装架、落基山博物馆Carbon County部分化石与OMNH58340头骨的完整活体美术复原；是不同个体而非同一完整标本。7米为属级估值，不是上述个体实测。肌肉厚度、皮肤、颜色和姿态为推断；不复制埋藏弯折或旧直立装架姿态。

scale.basis: NHM genus profile approximate length; not specimen measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Deep ribcage and thick muscular pelvic/tail-base volume; not thin scaled Dryosaurus or Mantellisaurus.
Very long deep proximal tail, smoothly tapering; substantial depth persists behind pelvis before gradual taper.
Small low elongated beaked head without crest/horns, short forelimbs and strong hindlimbs.
Complete four limbs, intact tail and head; neutral near-horizontal quadrupedal stance.
No claim the muscle volume or locomotor habit is directly fossilized.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: Actually inspected Manchester April mount (tail cropped), MOR partial skeleton in slab and Thomas2015Fig2 OMNH58340 skull; combined observations, not conflated identifiers.
